title: 3D Manufacturing Format
summary: 3D Manufacturing Format (3MF) is an open XML-based file format standard for additive manufacturing, maintained by the 3MF Consortium and published under ISO/IEC 25422:2025. It extends ZIP and XML to embed model data along with manufacturing parameters such as material assignments, colors, hotend and bed temperatures, feed rates, and support structures, eliminating the need for separate parameter files when distributing printable designs. The format is designed for simpler implementation than traditional CAD exchange formats and is supported by a broad ecosystem of CAD software developers and hardware manufacturers.

mechanisms.title: Containerized XML structure
mechanisms.explanation: The format packages model and manufacturing data as an XML-based archive using Open Packaging Conventions (ZIP), allowing structured storage of geometry, materials, colors, and process parameters within a single file.

mechanisms.title: Embedded manufacturing attributes
mechanisms.explanation: Manufacturing features such as hotend and bed temperatures, feed rates, part regions for multi-material printing, and support structures are embedded directly in the file, enabling hardware to interpret process parameters without external configuration.
